description: Fixed RAG evaluation corpus (E4-T03): fictional company Northwind Analytics Ltd. PDF and DOCX files are generated deterministically from these definitions; TXT is used as-is.

blocks.paragraph: Core working hours at Northwind Analytics are 10:00 to 16:00, Monday to Friday. Employees may choose a flexible start time between 07:00 and 10:00 as long as they work 37.5 hours per week.

Every full-time employee receives 27 days of paid annual leave per year in addition to public bank holidays. Part-time employees receive a pro-rata allowance. Leave requests must be submitted in the PeopleHub HR portal at least two weeks in advance and approved by your line manager.
Up to 5 days of unused annual leave can be carried over into the next leave year. Carried-over days must be used by 31 March, after which they expire.

If you are unwell, notify your line manager by phone or chat before 10:00 on the first day of absence. You can self-certify sickness for up to 7 calendar days. For absences longer than 7 days a fit note from a doctor is required.
The primary caregiver receives 26 weeks of parental leave at full pay. The secondary caregiver receives 4 weeks of parental leave at full pay, which can be taken within the first year.
Gifts or hospitality from suppliers or clients worth more than 50 pounds must be declared in the gifts register within 5 working days. Employees must not accept cash gifts of any amount.

pages: Expense and Travel Policy - Overview
All business expenses must be submitted in the Spendly expenses app within 30 days of being incurred.
An itemised receipt is required for every expense over 10 pounds.
Late claims may be rejected by Finance.
Travel Booking
Flights must be booked through the TravelPoint travel desk.
Economy class is required for flights shorter than 6 hours.
Business class is allowed for flights longer than 6 hours with written approval from a director.
Meals and Hotels
The daily meal allowance is 45 pounds for UK travel and 60 pounds for international travel.
Hotel costs are capped at 180 pounds per night in London and 120 pounds per night elsewhere in the UK.
Mileage and Non-Reimbursable Items
Business mileage in a personal car is reimbursed at 45 pence per mile for the first 10000 miles in a tax year.
Alcohol, fines and personal entertainment are not reimbursable.

documents.text:
IT Security Policy

Passwords must be at least 14 characters long and must be stored in the company password manager, 1Password. Never reuse your work password on other websites.

Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is mandatory for every company system, including email and the VPN.

If you receive a suspicious or phishing email, do not click any links. Report it with the Report Phish button in Outlook so the security team can investigate.

All laptops are encrypted with BitLocker or FileVault. USB storage devices such as memory sticks are blocked on company laptops.

When working on public Wi-Fi in cafes, hotels or airports you must connect to the NorthGate VPN before accessing company systems. Lock your screen whenever you leave your device unattended.

Remote Work Policy

Employees may work remotely for up to 3 days per week. Tuesday is the company-wide office day when all teams are expected in the office.

New remote workers can claim a one-off home office allowance of 300 pounds towards a desk or chair. Additional equipment such as a monitor can be requested from IT.

Working from another country is allowed for up to 20 working days per year, with prior approval from your manager and the People team.

blocks.paragraph: On your first day, arrive at the main reception at 09:30. Your manager will meet you, and you will collect your laptop and security badge from the IT service desk.
During your first week you must complete the mandatory security awareness and data protection training modules in the learning portal within your first 5 working days.
All new employees have a probation period of 6 months. Your manager will hold a formal probation review with you after 3 months.
Every new joiner is paired with a buddy from another team who helps with questions about tools, people and processes during the first two months.

pages: DataBridge Product FAQ - Connectors
DataBridge includes native connectors for Salesforce, HubSpot and PostgreSQL.
Custom connectors can be built with the DataBridge SDK.
Data Refresh
On the Pro plan, data is refreshed every 15 minutes.
On the Starter plan, data is refreshed once per hour.
Service Level Agreement
The Enterprise plan includes a 99.9 percent monthly uptime SLA.
Enterprise support tickets receive a first response within 4 business hours.

documents.text:
Incident Response Runbook

A SEV1 incident is a customer-facing outage or data loss. For a SEV1 the on-call engineer must acknowledge the page within 5 minutes and appoint an incident commander.

During a SEV1, the public status page must be updated at least every 30 minutes until the incident is resolved. Coordinate in the incident-war-room chat channel.

A blameless post-incident review must be held within 5 business days of resolution, and its action items tracked in the engineering backlog.

Supplier Contact Notes

Acme Office Supplies handles stationery orders. Orders are placed by the office manager on the first Monday of each month.
